purpose: Machine-readable evidence registry for Sinag ng Kaalaman language-content intake and validation.

authority_tiers.A: Official curriculum, policy, or government learning-resource authority
authority_tiers.B: Institutional linguistic reference or academic language resource
authority_tiers.E: Historical or supplementary reference requiring additional review

sources.name: DepEd Learning Resource Portal
sources.license_summary: Copyright and conditions of use vary by resource.
sources.notes: Use as a reference repository. Review the conditions of each specific resource before copying, adapting, or redistributing it.

sources.name: DepEd MATATAG Curriculum Phase 1
sources.notes: Normative curriculum reference for current language scope; not a source for automatic text import.

sources.name: MATATAG Filipino Curriculum Guide, Grades 4 and 7
sources.notes: Use Grade 4 portions for present scope. Do not infer learner-facing grade labels from this document.

sources.name: DepEd Order No. 34, s. 2013 - Ortograpiyang Pambansa
sources.notes: Primary project reference for Filipino orthographic and syllabification decisions where applicable.

sources.name: DepEd Order No. 76, s. 2011 - Learning Resources Management and Development System
sources.notes: Reference standard for Sinag learning-resource QA; the project does not claim formal DepEd certification.

sources.name: LRMDS Assessment, Evaluation, Development, and Production Guidelines
sources.notes: Use as process guidance for evaluation and development, including translation and mother-tongue resource workflows.

sources.name: Panugod sa Pagbasa (Hiligaynon Primer) - Learning Material
sources.license_summary: DepEd Learning Portal lists copyright ownership by DepEd and conditions permitting reproduce, use, copy, and print.
sources.notes: Useful for Hiligaynon phonological and spelling evidence. Grade 1 presentation level should not be treated as Sinag's target level.

sources.name: Panugod sa Pagbasa (Hiligaynon Primer) - Teacher's Guide
sources.license_summary: DepEd Learning Portal lists copyright ownership by DepEd and conditions permitting reproduce, use, copy, and print.
sources.notes: Companion teaching reference to the learning material; reference-only for Sinag content design.

sources.name: UP Diksiyonaryong Filipino
sources.license_summary: Reference use only unless specific reuse permission is established.
sources.notes: Use to cross-check Filipino lexical forms and meanings; do not bulk copy entries.

sources.name: UP Diksiyonaryong Hiligaynon-Filipino
sources.license_summary: Reference use only unless specific reuse permission is established.
sources.notes: Institutional lexical cross-check. Do not treat availability as permission for wholesale redistribution.

sources.name: Hiligaynon Reference Grammar
sources.notes: Use as linguistic evidence. Keep source-derived material identifiable and within license constraints.

sources.name: Knowledge Channel Learning Resources
sources.notes: Use as supplementary calibration evidence, not as sole authority for lexical, spelling, or grammar decisions.

sources.name: DepEd Philippines YouTube Channel
sources.notes: Use as presentation and age-level calibration. Do not treat videos as the sole authority for canonical lexical decisions.

sources.name: Princeton WordNet
sources.license_summary: Use, copy, modify, and distribute permitted subject to WordNet license notice requirements.
sources.notes: Definitions and glosses still require grade-suitability review before learner-facing use.

sources.name: Tatoeba textual sentence exports
sources.license_summary: Main textual exports CC BY 2.0 FR; some original sentences available under CC0 1.0.
sources.notes: Prefer CC0 records when practical. Any imported sentence must remain provenance-aware and be reviewed for learner suitability.

sources.name: HiliSenti v1
sources.license_summary: Dataset CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; repository code MIT.
sources.notes: Reference-only by default. Do not silently import dataset records into canonical content.

sources.name: jhellingman/phildict
sources.license_summary: No top-level GitHub license declared; underlying works must be reviewed individually.
sources.notes: Do not treat repository availability as redistribution permission or historical 'Visayan' as automatically equivalent to modern Hiligaynon.

sources.name: Diccionario Ingles-Español-Tagalog
sources.author: Sofronio G. Calderón
sources.license_summary: Project Gutenberg reports public domain in the USA; Gutenberg terms and local jurisdiction must be checked.
sources.notes: Historical spelling and vocabulary require modern Filipino review.

sources.name: A Bisayan Grammar and related lexical comparison material
sources.license_summary: Project Gutenberg-hosted historical work; source and jurisdiction review required.
sources.notes: Historical 'Bisayan' must not automatically be mapped to modern Hiligaynon.
